units.literal: Before long Jing inspector Shen Youzhi rebelled; Gaodi said to Yan, "The realm is in such turmoil—what do you think?"

units.zh: 是時軍書表記，皆使淹具草。
units.en: In those days every army dispatch and memorial passed through Yan's hand.
units.literal: At that time military reports and memorials were all drafted by Yan.

units.zh: 時明帝作相，因謂淹曰：「君昔在尚書中，非公事不妄行，在官寬猛能折衷；
units.en: Mingdi was regent and told Yan, "In the secretariat you never moved without public business; in office you could balance mercy and severity;
units.literal: Mingdi was then chief minister and said to Yan, "When you were in the Masters of Writing you never acted without public cause; in office you balanced lenity and severity;

units.zh: 淹答曰：「今日之事，可謂當官而行，更恐才劣志薄，不足以仰稱明旨耳。」
units.en: Yan answered, "Today's charge is to act as the post requires; I only fear my gift is small and my resolve thin for your clear command."
units.literal: Yan answered, "Today's task may be called doing the office as it demands; I only fear talent too slight and will too thin to rise to your bright intent."

units.zh: 明帝卽位，爲車騎臨海王長史。
units.en: When Mingdi succeeded, Yan became chief of staff to the valiant-cavalry prince of Linhai.
units.literal: When Mingdi took the throne, Yan was made chief of staff to the Valiant Cavalry Prince of Linhai.

units.zh: 及義師至新林，淹微服來奔，高祖板爲冠軍將軍，秘書監如故，尋兼司徒左長史。
units.en: When the righteous army reached Xinlin, Yan came over in plain clothes. Gaozu provisionally appointed him Champion General, leaving him as Palace Library Director as before, and soon made him concurrently left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: When the righteous army reached Xinlin, Yan came over in plain clothes. Gaozu provisionally appointed him Champion General, leaving him as Palace Library Director as before, and soon made him concurrently left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 普通四年，高祖追念淹功，復封蒍吳昌伯，邑如先。
units.en: In Putong year 4 Gaozu remembered Yan's service and made Wei marquis of Wuchang again, with the old fief.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Putong, Gaozu recalled Yan's merit and re-enfeoffed Wei as Marquis of Wuchang, fief as before.

units.zh: 謝超宗
units.en: Xie Chaozong
units.literal: Xie Chaozong

units.zh: 謝超宗，陳郡陽夏人也。
units.en: Xie Chaozong was a man of Yangxia in Chen commandery.
units.literal: Xie Chaozong was a native of Yangxia in Chen commandery.

units.zh: :　　風聞征北諮議參軍謝超宗，根性浮險，率情躁薄。
units.en: It is reported that northern-campaign adviser Chaozong is by nature unstable and rash.
units.literal: It is heard that northern-campaign adviser Chaozong's root nature is floating and dangerous, his conduct rash and thin.

units.zh: :　　今月九日，治書侍御史臣司馬侃啓彈征北諮議參軍事謝超宗，稱「根性昏動，率心險放，悖議爽眞，囂辭犯實，親朋忍聞，衣冠掩目，輙收付廷尉法獄治罪」。
units.en: On the ninth of this month, your servant Sima Kan, Reviewing Secretary and Attendant Censor, submitted an impeachment against Xie Chaozong, advisory staff officer for the Campaigning-North command, saying: "His root nature is muddled and rash; his heart is dangerous and unrestrained; his perverse arguments violate truth and his clamorous words offend fact. Kin and friends cannot bear to hear him; gentlemen cover their eyes. He should at once be arrested, delivered to the law prison of the Chamberlain for Law Enforcement, and punished for his crime."
units.literal: On the ninth of this month reviewing-secretary censor Sima Kan memorialized northern-campaign adviser Chaozong, saying "his root nature is dull and rash, heart dangerous and unrestrained, rebellious discourse offends truth, arrogant words violate fact — kin and friends cannot bear to hear, caps and gowns cover their eyes — urge seizure and delivery to the tribunal."

units.zh: 詔徙越州，行至豫章，上敕豫章內史虞悰曰：「謝超宗令於彼賜自盡，勿傷其形骸。」
units.en: An edict exiled him to Yue Province. When he reached Yuzhang, the emperor ordered Yu Cong, Interior Minister of Yuzhang: "Have Xie Chaozong take his own life there; do not injure his body."
units.literal: An edict exiled him to Yue; reaching Zhang commandery the emperor issued an edict Zhang interior governor Yu Cong: "Order Chaozong to take his own life there — do not harm his body."

units.zh: 超宗元嘉末得還。
units.en: Chaozong returned home at the end of the Yuanjia reign.
units.literal: Chaozong was able to return at the end of Yuanjia.

units.zh: 新安王子鸞，孝武帝寵子，超宗以選補王國常侍。
units.en: Prince Ziluan of Xin'an, Emperor Xiaowu's favorite son, took Chaozong as constant attendant in his household.
units.literal: Prince Ziluan of Xin'an, the Xiaowu emperor's favored son — Chaozong by selection was made constant attendant in the princedom.

units.zh: 超宗議以爲「片辭折獄，寸言挫衆，魯史褒貶，孔《論》興替，皆無俟繁而後秉裁。
units.en: Chaozong argued: "One phrase can decide a lawsuit, one word can overturn the crowd — the Lu historian's praise and blame, the Analects on rise and fall, need no prolixity before judgment.
units.literal: Chaozong argued: "A phrase decides a case, a word defeats the crowd — the Lu historian's praise and blame, Confucius's Discourses on rise and fall, all need no prolixity before judgment is taken.

units.zh: 與慧休道人來往，好學，有文辭，盛得名譽。
units.en: He kept company with the monk Huixiu, loved learning, wrote well, and won great renown.
units.literal: He associated with the monk Huixiu, loved learning, had literary talent, and gained great renown.

units.zh: 有司奏撰立郊廟歌，敕司徒褚淵、侍中謝朏、散騎侍郎孔稚珪、太學博士王咺之、總明學士劉融、何法冏、何曇秀十人竝作，超宗辭獨見用。
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized requesting that suburban and ancestral-temple hymns be composed. The emperor ordered ten men to write them: Minister over the Masses Chu Yuan, Attendant-in-Ordinary Xie Fei, Scattered Cavalry Gentleman Kong Zhigui, National University Erudite Wang Xuanzhi, Zongming Academy scholars Liu Rong, He Fajiong, He Tanxiu, and others. Only Chaozong's wording was used.
units.literal: The relevant office memorialized to compose suburban and temple hymns; the emperor ordered Chancellor Chu Yuan, attendant Xie Fei, attendant at leisure Kong Zhigui, Erudite Wang Xuanzhi, Zongming scholars Liu Rong, He Fajiong, and He Tanxiu — ten in all — to compose; only Chaozong's hymn was used.

units.zh: 解褐奉朝請。
units.en: He left coarse cloth as a court gentleman attending audience.
units.literal: He left coarse cloth as court gentleman attending audience.

units.zh: 世祖卽位，使掌國史，除竟陵王征北諮議參軍，領記室。
units.en: When Emperor Wu ascended he managed the national history and was adviser on the Prince of Jingling's northern campaign with charge of the records office.
units.literal: When the Shizu took the throne he was made to manage the national history, and made adviser to the Prince of Jingling's northern campaign with charge of the records office.

units.zh: 超宗娶張敬兒女爲子婦，上甚疑之。
units.en: Chaozong married his son to Zhang Jing'er's daughter; the emperor grew suspicious.
units.literal: Chaozong took Zhang Jing'er's daughter as his son's wife; the emperor was very suspicious.

units.zh: 明年，超宗門生王永先又告超宗子才卿死罪二十餘條。
units.en: The next year his student Wang Yongxian reported his son Caiqing for more than twenty capital crimes.
units.literal: The next year Chaozong's student Wang Yongxian again reported Chaozong's son Caiqing for more than twenty capital crimes.

units.zh: 祖靈運，宋臨川內史。
units.en: His grandfather Lingyun had been Song governor of Linchuan.
units.literal: His grandfather Lingyun was Song grand administrator of Linchuan.

units.zh: 及卽位，轉黃門郎。
units.en: When the emperor ascended he was transferred to the yellow gate.
units.literal: When the emperor took the throne he was transferred gentleman of the yellow gate.

units.zh: 轉新安王撫軍行參軍。
units.en: He was made staff officer on the Prince of Xin'an's Pacification Army.
units.literal: He was transferred staff officer on the Pacification Army of the Prince of Xin'an.

units.zh: 泰始初，爲建安王司徒參軍事，尚書殿中郎。
units.en: At the start of Taishi he served Prince Jian'an's secretariat and was director of the palace at the Secretariat.
units.literal: At the start of Taishi he was staff officer to Prince Jian'an's secretariat, and director of the palace at the Secretariat.

units.zh: 遷司徒主簿，丹陽丞。
units.en: He was made chief clerk of the secretariat and aide of Danyang.
units.literal: He was moved chief clerk of the secretariat and aide of Danyang.

units.zh: 取爲長史、臨淮太守。
units.en: He was made chief clerk and governor of Linhuai.
units.literal: He was taken as chief clerk and grand administrator of Linhuai.

units.zh: 粲旣誅，太祖以超宗爲義興太守，
units.en: After Can was executed the founding emperor made Chaozong governor of Yixing.
units.literal: When Can was executed the founding emperor made Chaozong grand administrator of Yixing,

units.zh: 昇明二年，坐公事免。
units.en: In the second year of Shengming, he was dismissed for a public-affairs offense.
units.literal: In the second year of Shengming, he was dismissed for a public-affairs offense.

units.zh: 板爲驃騎諮議。
units.en: He was appointed by patent adviser to the Rapid Cavalry.
units.literal: He was appointed by patent adviser to the Rapid Cavalry.

units.zh: 以失儀出爲南郡王中軍司馬。
units.en: For breach of decorum he was sent out as army supervisor to the Prince of Nanjun.
units.literal: For breach of decorum he was sent out as army supervisor of the Prince of Nanjun.

units.zh: 爲省司所奏，以怨望免官，禁錮十年。
units.en: The provincial office memorialized; for resentful speech he was dismissed and confined ten years.
units.literal: The provincial office memorialized; for resentful speech he was dismissed and confined ten years.

units.zh: 超宗下廷尉，一宿髮白皓首。
units.en: Chaozong was sent to the tribunal; in one night his hair turned white.
units.literal: Chaozong was sent down to the tribunal; in one night his hair turned white.

units.zh: 三年，都令史駱宰議策秀才考格，五問竝得爲上，四、三爲中，二爲下，一不合與第。
units.en: In year three, bureau clerk Luo Zai proposed the examination standard for eminent scholars: five questions all top make highest grade, four or three middle, two lower, one fail earns no rank.
units.literal: In year three, bureau clerk Luo Zai deliberated the examination standard for recommending eminent scholars: in five questions all upper makes top grade, four or three middle, two lower, one failing earns no rank.

units.zh: 永明元年，敬兒誅，超宗謂丹陽尹李安民曰：「往年殺韓信，今年殺彭越，尹欲何計？」
units.en: In Yongming year one, when Jing'er was executed, Chaozong told Li Anmin: "Last year Han Xin; this year Peng Yue — what will you do, Governor?"
units.literal: In the first year of Yongming, when Jing'er was executed, Chaozong told Danyang governor Li Anmin: "Last year they killed Han Xin; this year Peng Yue — what plan does the governor intend?"

units.zh: 王母殷淑儀卒，超宗作誄奏之，帝大嗟賞。
units.en: When the prince's mother Lady Yin Shuyi died, Chaozong wrote a dirge and presented it; the emperor was deeply impressed.
units.literal: When the prince's mother Lady Yin Shuyi died, Chaozong composed a dirge and presented it; the emperor greatly sighed in admiration.

units.zh: 夫表事之淵，析理之會，豈必委牘方切治道。
units.en: The depth of memorials and the crux of analysis — must one always heap documents before the Way is served?
units.literal: The depth of memorializing affairs and the meeting-point of analysis — must one always pile documents before the Way is touched?

units.zh: 非患對不盡問，患以恒文弗奇。
units.en: The worry is not incomplete answers but flat phrasing without brilliance.
units.literal: The worry is not incomplete answers but constant wording without marvel.

units.zh: 必使一通峻正，寧劣五通而常；
units.en: If one answer must be stern and correct, better five merely adequate passes;
units.literal: If one passage must be stern and correct, better five passes that are merely adequate;

units.zh: 與其俱奇，必使一亦宜採。」
units.en: if all are brilliant, even one fine answer should count."
units.literal: if all are marvelous, even one should be taken."

units.zh: 太祖爲領軍，數與超宗共屬文，愛其才翰。
units.en: When the founding emperor was Defender General they often wrote together; he cherished Chaozong's talent.
units.literal: When the founding emperor was Defender General they often composed texts together and he loved Chaozong's literary gift.

units.zh: 在直省常醉，上召見，語及北方事，超宗曰：「虜動來二十年矣，佛出亦無如何！」
units.en: In the direct offices he was often drunk; summoned to discuss the north he said: "The barbarians have stirred twenty years — even the Buddha could do nothing!"
units.literal: In the direct-service offices he was often drunk; the emperor summoned him and spoke of northern affairs; Chaozong said: "The barbarians have been stirring twenty years — even if the Buddha appeared, what could be done!"

units.zh: 超宗怨望，謂人曰：「我今日政應爲司驢。」
units.en: Chaozong resented it and said: "Today I ought to be Director of Mules."
units.literal: Chaozong resented it and told others: "Today I ought rightly to be Director of Mules."

units.zh: 超宗撫掌笑戲曰：「落水三公，墮車僕射。」
units.en: Chaozong clapped and mocked: "The third duke in the water, the vice director off his carriage."
units.literal: Chaozong clapped his hands in mockery: "The third duke who fell in the water, the vice director who fell from his carriage."

units.zh: 曰：「超宗殊有鳳毛，恐靈運復出。」
units.en: He said: "Chaozong truly has phoenix plumage — I fear Lingyun has been reborn."
units.literal: He said: "Chaozong truly has phoenix down — I fear Lingyun is born again."

units.zh: 衞將軍袁粲聞之，謂太祖曰：「超宗開亮迥悟，善可與語。」
units.en: Defender General Yuan Can heard and told the founding emperor: "Chaozong is open, bright, and penetrating — good to talk with."
units.literal: Defender General Yuan Can heard of it and told the founding emperor: "Chaozong is open, bright, and far-seeing — pleasant to speak with."

units.zh: 爲人仗才使酒，多所陵忽。
units.en: He relied on talent and wine and often slighted others.
units.literal: By nature he relied on talent and drank wine, and often slighted others.

units.zh: 贊曰：超宗蘊文，祖構餘芬。
units.en: Eulogy: Chaozong held literature, ancestral fragrance lingering.
units.literal: Eulogy: Chaozong stored literature, ancestors' lingering fragrance.

units.zh: 超宗旣坐，飲酒數甌，辭氣橫出，太祖對之甚歡。
units.en: Once seated, after several cups Chaozong's eloquence burst forth; the founding emperor delighted in him.
units.literal: Chaozong having sat, after several cups his words poured forth; the founding emperor was very pleased with him.

units.zh: 上積懷超宗輕慢，使兼中丞袁彖奏曰：
units.en: The emperor's long resentment of Chaozong's insolence led acting censor Yuan Can to memorialize:
units.literal: The emperor's long resentment of Chaozong's insolence made him have acting censor Yuan Can memorialize, saying:

units.zh: :　　輙攝白從王永先到臺辨問「超宗有何罪過，詣諸貴皆有不遜言語，竝依事列對」。
units.en: Your servant sent clerk Wang Yongxian to examine "what crimes Chaozong had — visits to the great all involved insolent speech; let him answer item by item."
units.literal: Your servant took clerk Wang Yongxian to the tribunal to examine "what crimes Chaozong had — visiting the great all used insolent speech; let him answer item by item."

units.zh: 永先列稱：「主人超宗恒行來詣諸貴要，每多觸忤，言語怨懟。
units.en: Yongxian listed: "My master constantly visits the powerful; he often offends them with resentful, raging speech.
units.literal: Yongxian listed: "My master Chaozong constantly goes to visit the great; he often gives offense, speech resentful and raging.

units.zh: 超宗罪自已彰，宜附常准。
units.en: Chaozong's guilt is clear; the usual standard should apply.
units.literal: Chaozong's crimes are already clear; he should follow the usual standard.

units.zh: :　　超宗少無行檢，長習民慝。
units.en: Chaozong in youth lacked conduct; in age he learned popular vices.
units.literal: Chaozong in youth had no conduct; in age he learned the people's vices.

units.zh: 請以見事免超宗所居官，解領記室。
units.en: We ask that he be removed from office and relieved of the records office.
units.literal: Request that by the present affair he be removed from his posts and relieved of the records office.

units.zh: 超宗品第未入簡奏，臣輙奉白簡以聞。
units.en: Chaozong's rank has not entered the brief; your servant reports by white brief.
units.literal: Chaozong's rank-grade has not entered the brief memorial; your servant ventures a white brief to report.

units.zh: 尋超宗植性險戾，稟行凶詖，豺狼野心，久暴遐邇。
units.en: Chaozong's nature is dangerous, conduct vicious, wolf-heart long exposed to all.
units.literal: Chaozong's planted nature is dangerous and perverse, his endowed conduct vicious and false, wolf and jackal heart, long exposed near and far.

units.zh: 張敬兒潛圖反噬，罰未塞諐，而稱怨痛枉，形于言貌。
units.en: Zhang Jing'er plotted rebellion; punishment had not settled all guilt, yet Chaozong spoke of wrongful death openly.
units.literal: Zhang Jing'er secretly plotted rebellion; punishment had not settled the guilt, yet he spoke of grievance and wrongful death, form on face and bearing.

units.zh: 況超宗罪愈四凶，過窮南竹，雖下輙收，而文止黃案，沈浮旡見，輕重相乖，此而不糾，憲綱將替。
units.en: Chaozong's crime exceeds the Four Evils — though seizure was ordered, the memorial stopped at the yellow dossier; if uncorrected, law's net fails.
units.literal: Chaozong's crime exceeds the Four Evils and surpasses the Nanzhu cases — though seizure was ordered, the text stopped at the yellow dossier; float and sink unseen, light and heavy at odds — if this is not corrected, law's net will fail.

units.zh: 詔曰：「超宗釁同大逆，罪不容誅。
units.en: The edict said: "Chaozong's guilt equals great treason; the crime cannot be pardoned.
units.literal: The edict said: "Chaozong's guilt equals great treason; crime cannot bear pardon.

units.zh: 卿不見謝超宗，其才地二三，故在卿前，事殆是百分不一。
units.en: Have you not seen Xie Chaozong? His talent stands two or three ranks above yours — yet his case was perhaps one hundredth unlike yours.
units.literal: Have you not seen Xie Chaozong? His talent and standing are two or threefold yours — he stands before you — the affair is perhaps one percent unlike you.

units.zh: 八月壬午，詔稱先帝遺詔，以護軍將軍武陵王曄爲衛將軍，征南大將軍陳顯達卽本號，竝開府儀同三司，尚書左僕射西昌侯鸞爲尚書令。
units.en: Eighth month, day renwu: by the late emperor's will, Protected-Army General Xiao Ye, prince of Wuling, became defender general; Chen Xianda, general who conquers the south, kept his rank, and both were given secretariat parity with the three excellencies; Xiao Luan, marquis of Xichang and left vice director of the masters of writing, became director of the masters of writing.
units.literal: Eighth month, day renwu: citing the late emperor's testament, Protected-Army General Prince Ye of Wuling was made Defender General; General Who Conquers the South Chen Xianda kept his original title—both with ceremonial parity equal to the Three Excellencies; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Marquis Luan of Xichang, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 夏四月辛巳，衞將軍、開府儀同三司武陵王曄薨。
units.en: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: Xiao Ye, prince of Wuling, defender general with secretariat parity equal to the three excellencies, died.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: Defender General, Grand-Master-with-Ceremonial-Parity-equal-to-Three-Excellencies, Prince Ye of Wuling, died.

units.zh: 世檦亦知帝昏縱，密謂其黨茹法珍、梅蟲兒曰：「何世天子無要人，但阿儂貨主惡耳。」
units.en: Shibang knew too that the emperor was muddled and reckless; in secret he told his clique Ru Fazhen and Mei Chong'er, "What reign ever lacked men the throne must have? Only the Old Fellow is a rotten master."
units.literal: Shibang also knew the emperor was benighted and dissolute; secretly he told his partisans Ru Fazhen and Mei Chong'er, "In what age does a Son of Heaven lack men he needs? Only the Old Fellow is a vile master."

units.zh: 自是法珍、蟲兒用事，竝為外監，口稱詔敕；
units.en: After that Fazhen and Chong'er ran affairs, both as outer supervisors, issuing orders in the emperor's voice;
units.literal: From then on Fazhen and Chong'er held sway, both made outer supervisors, and spoke in the name of edicts;

units.zh: 崔慧景平後，法珍封餘干縣男，蟲兒封竟陵縣男。
units.en: When Cui Huijing fell, Fazhen became baron of Yugan and Chong'er baron of Jingling.
units.literal: After Cui Huijing was pacified, Fazhen was enfeoffed as Baron of Yugan and Chong'er as Baron of Jingling.

units.zh: 王司徒清虛寡欲，善於全己，昔曹參亦綜此道，著畫一之稱也。
units.en: He praised Wang Dao's quiet survival craft.
units.literal: Director Wang Dao is clear-minded with few desires, skilled at preserving himself—like Han's Cao Shen who earned praise for consistent rule.

units.zh: 彭城劉孝綽、河東裴子野、吳郡張嵊等每共論《周易》及《喪服》儀，酬應如響。
units.en: Pengcheng Liu Xiaochuo, Hedong Pei Ziye, Wu commandery Zhang Sheng, and others often debated the Book of Changes and mourning-garment ritual with him; his replies came like an echo.
units.literal: Pengcheng Liu Xiaochuo, Hedong Pei Ziye, Wu commandery Zhang Sheng, and others often debated the Book of Changes and mourning-garment ritual with him; his replies came like an echo.

units.zh: 師次秣陵，東昏遣大將王珍國，盛兵朱雀門，衆號二十萬，度航請戰。
units.en: At Moling, Dong Hun sent Grand General Wang Zhenguo with a host said to number two hundred thousand at Zhuque Gate; they crossed the floating bridge and offered battle.
units.literal: When the army reached Moling, Dong Hun sent Grand General Wang Zhenguo, who massed troops at Zhuque Gate; the host was said to number two hundred thousand, and they crossed the floating bridge to request battle.

units.zh: 若爾，何以不言『武王伐紂，何意不立微子而輔之，苟貪天下？』」
units.en: If so, why not say, 'When King Wu attacked King Zhou, why did he not establish Weizi and assist him, but greedily seize the realm under Heaven?'"
units.literal: If so, why not say: 'When King Wu attacked Zhou, why did he not establish Weizi and assist him, but greedily desired the realm under Heaven?'"

units.zh: 明年，青州刺史張稷爲土人徐道角所殺，絢又遣司馬茅榮伯討平之。
units.en: Next year Zhang Ji of Qingzhou was killed by Xu Daojiao; Xuan sent Major Mao Rongbo to crush the revolt.
units.literal: The next year Qing province Inspector Zhang Ji was killed by the local man Xu Daojiao; Xuan again sent Major Mao Rongbo to suppress and settle it.

units.zh: 九年，遷假節、督北兗州緣淮諸軍事、振遠將軍、北兗州刺史。
units.en: In year nine he took brevet staff, command along the Huai frontier, Quelling Distance General, and North Yanzhou.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to brevet staff, Area Commander of North Yanzhou forces along the Huai, Quelling Distance General, and North Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 永明中，錢唐唐㝢之反，別衆破東陽，崇之遇害。
units.en: During Yongming, Tang Yu of Qiantang rebelled; a rebel detachment overran Dongyang, and Chongzhi was killed in the fighting.
units.literal: In the Yongming era, Tang Yu of Qiantang rebelled; a separate force defeated Dongyang, and Chongzhi was killed.
